title: Model Discovery for Virtual Chaos Engineering with Incomplete Tracing: An eBPF Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.23313v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model-based fault experiments can assess the consequences of component failures before intervening in a running application. Recent work on model discovery and graph simulation acquired operation models from application telemetry and used them for availability prediction. Applying this approach to operational legacy systems raises an acquisition problem: the required traces may be absent or incomplete, while introducing them can require changes across heterogeneous components. These systems continue to serve business operations during extended maintenance and modernization. External observation offers a possible route to model-based fault analysis before a tracing retrofit, but collecting telemetry does not by itself establish that an executable operation model can be obtained. translated_title: 面向虚拟混沌工程的不完整追踪模型发现：一项eBPF研究
translated_abstract: 基于模型的故障实验可以在对运行中的应用程序进行干预之前评估组件故障的后果。近期关于模型发现和图模拟的研究从应用程序遥测数据中获取操作模型，并将其用于可用性预测。将这种方法应用于仍在运行的遗留系统时会产生一个获取难题：所需的追踪数据可能缺失或不完整，而引入这些数据可能需要对异构组件进行改动。这些系统在漫长的维护和现代化改造期间持续支撑业务运营。外部观测为在追踪系统改造之前进行基于模型的故障分析提供了一条可能的途径，但仅仅收集遥测数据本身并不能保证能够获得可执行的操作模型。我们使用扩展伯克利数据包过滤器观测技术和现有的基于图的建模方法来研究这条途径。一项包含108个案例的研究改变了应用程序的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文探索了利用eBPF外部观测技术在追踪数据缺失或不完整的遗留系统上发现操作模型，从而在无需改造追踪系统的情况下实现虚拟混沌工程中的基于模型的故障分析。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates using eBPF external observations to discover operational models on legacy systems with missing or incomplete tracing, enabling model-based fault analysis for virtual chaos engineering without requiring a tracing retrofit.
